calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    f.channel_code,
    COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_code

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT w.web_order_id) as order_count,
    SUM(w.order_total_gross) as order_total_gross
FROM fact_web_order w
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON DATE(w.order_ts_utc) = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    channel_group
FROM dim_channel
ORDER BY channel_id

SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
    AND (f.channel_code = 'WB' OR f.channel_id IN (2, 3))
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
